description: Na₄Ge₂Se₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.29 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with five NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.28 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-15°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.17 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.38 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with six NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.23 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with three NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-84°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.09 Å. There are four inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Ge and three Se atoms. The Ge-Ge bond length is 2.48 Å. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Ge-Se bond length. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and one longer (2.49 Å) Ge-Se bond length. In the third Ge site, Ge is bonded to one Ge and three Se atoms to form distorted GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with seven NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with two NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-83°. There are a spread of Ge-Se bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.48 Å. In the fourth Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Ge-Se bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.48 Å. There are ten inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramids, and edges with eight SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-83°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Ge octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra, edges with nine SeNa₅Ge octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-89°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and two Ge atoms to form distorted SeNa₄Ge₂ octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Ge octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramid, and edges with eight SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-92°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with five SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramids, and edges with ten SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-90°. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and two Ge atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-97°. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Ge octahedra, edges with nine SeNa₅Ge octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-85°. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-92°. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with six SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with nine SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-85°. In the ninth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with five SeNa₅Ge octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramid, edges with nine SeNa₅Ge octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-77°. In the tenth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with six SeNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃Ge₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one GeGeSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with nine SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-88°.
